data.promptProse: In the unfamiliar northern town's snowy square, Sora Kasugano turns toward the viewer with a calm look of finally arriving somewhere. Her white wool coat, grey scarf and warm trousers sit securely above winter boots, breath condensing before her face. The medium portrait includes the snow-covered paving and distant building fronts. Low winter sun outlines white hair and scarf fibers, with pale blue ground shadows separating her coat from the snow.
